Construct a canonical simulation-ensemble object

Source: R/ensemble_source.R
fb_ensemble.Rd

Builds an fb_ensemble – quorum's canonical container for a parameter-to-output simulation ensemble (contract C5, inst/ensemble_source_contract.md). params and outputs are the (X, Y) an emulator or surrogate trains on; output_dims and observed add the calibration framing when present. quorum never executes the simulator (APSIM is run upstream by apsimx); this is the ingest floor the methods-intense consumers share.

Usage

fb_ensemble(
  params,
  outputs,
  observed = NULL,
  output_dims = NULL,
  provenance = list()
)

Arguments

params

A data.frame, one row per parameter set, columns the simulator's input parameters. Row order is the ensemble key.

outputs

A data.frame row-aligned to params (nrow(outputs) == nrow(params)), columns the output dimensions.

observed

Optional named numeric of target observations; names a subset of colnames(outputs). NULL for a pure forward ensemble.

output_dims

Optional data.frame, one row per outputs column, labelling it (e.g. site, season, day, variable). NULL when outputs are unlabelled.

provenance

A named list of provenance fields; source is filled with "raw" when absent.

Value

An object of class c("fb_ensemble", "list").

See also

as_fb_ensemble(), verify_fb_ensemble(), read_fb_ensemble().

Examples

e <- fb_ensemble(
  params = data.frame(k = c(0.1, 0.2, 0.3)),
  outputs = data.frame(yield = c(4.1, 4.6, 5.0))
)
verify_fb_ensemble(e)$ok
#> [1] TRUE
